description: This Dart source file defines the `LocalDb` class which provides a lightweight SQLite database interface for a restaurant application. It handles creation and seeding of tables for menu categories, items, orders, and reviews, supporting offline data persistence and sync scaffolding.

classes.name: LocalDb
classes.description: A class that manages the SQLite database connection and schema, offering an instance method for initialization and a getter for the raw database object.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: A static async method that initializes the database, creates tables, seeds initial data, and returns an instance of `LocalDb`.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: A getter that provides access to the underlying `Database` instance.
